Title: Azure Data Factory supports preserving metadata during file copy

Body.Content:
Azure Data Factory copy activity now supports preserving metadata during file copy among Amazon S3, Azure Blob, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2. The following attributes can be copied along with files:

  • All customer-specified metadata.
  • These five data store built-in system properties—contentType, contentLanguage, contentEncoding, contentDisposition, and cacheControl.

Learn more.
